items.desc: prefix-aware routing fell back to windowed qps, which pinned sessions to saturated backends; now least-inflight
handle-metric staleness compared clocks across machines; now aged by the controller's monotonic receive time
p/d decode dropped multi_modal_data, so same-size images collided in the prefix cache and reused each other's kv
zephyr and tinyllama chat templates were misdetected as phi, so the first decode step returned eos
a missing dcgm hostname label failed validation inside a swallowed task and hung aiperf profile
go2 mjx back-thigh range and calf torque (24 vs 45.43 nm) had drifted from the urdf; now they match
execution_complete_ was a plain bool read outside its mutex, a c++ data race; now std::atomic
sky/ground ambient and per-light color for SensorCamera, wired into the warp kernel; defaults render unchanged
15 mjcf joint ranges and every motor limit had drifted from the urdf; synced, plus a script that fails on drift
the operator and its helm hook jobs ran without a securityContext; restricted defaults for k8s and openshift
the rdma shared device plugin assumed /var/lib/kubelet; the kubelet root is now configurable through helm
the controller oomkilled at 128Mi on ~141 nodes (idle 130-156Mi); raised to 256Mi with sizing guidance
non-fp8 gemm never set cublaslt's bias dtype, so a bf16 bias read as fp32 ran out of bounds; now rejected
rms_norm always failed on an unconditional bias lookup and lazy VarMap init broke; both work again
nemotron-h checkpoints saved with a singular embedding key failed dtensor load; both key forms now map

projects.alt: sea of fog: typesafe's new jev model takes napoleon's bait at austerlitz 79% of the time; one warning line cuts that to 44%
